channel.title: International Business Times India - Article Feed
channel.description: Latest articles from International Business Times India (ibtimes.co.in)

item.title: The Raja Saab movie review: Critics give Prabhas starrer a thumbs down
item.description: Director Maruthi's The Raja Saab starring Prabhas, Sanjay Dutt and Malavika Mohanan has garnered negative reviews and average ratings from the film critics.

item.title: BJP worker stripping case: K'taka govt to hand over case to CID
item.description: He clarified that the police did not allow the woman to be stripped and that they took immediate action. "I have already shared information with the media that the police did not disrobe her and that she did it herself. Even so, the matter needs to be investigated in detail. Only an investigation will bring complete clarity," he said.

item.title: 'Bengal CM guilty of serious penal offence': BJP blasts Mamata Banerjee over 'dramatic showdown' with ED
item.description: "The entire action of the Chief Minister is not just unethical, irresponsible, unconstitutional, but she has put the entire government and constitutional conventions to shame. The question arises - is that what is Mamata's linkage to that consultancy firm? There are a lot of suspicious circumstances surrounding it, and this shows that she was trying to rescue something sensitive implicating her and the party," Prasad said.

item.title: O Romeo poster: Shahid Kapoor flaunts full-body tattoos in blood-soaked maniac avatar [reactions]
item.description: Shahid Kapoor has unveiled the first look of his upcoming film O'Romeo, directed by Vishal Bhardwaj. The poster features a fierce and blood-soaked Shahid Kapoor. Sharing the poster on social media, he wrote, "Romeo O Romeo, where art thou O'ROMEO!" The film's trailer will be released on Saturday, January 10, 2026.

item.title: MEA says India still keen on trade deal with US, rejects Commerce Secy Lutnick's comments
item.description: The US Commerce Secretary claimed he asked Prime Minister Modi to call the President to close the deal. However, he said India was "uncomfortable doing it, so Mr Modi didn't call".

item.title: Exports of K-beauty products hit all-time high in 2025: Data
item.description: The number of countries importing South Korean cosmetics reached 202 in 2025, up from 172 in 2024. Shipments to Europe, the Middle East, Southwest Asia and Latin America continued to grow, while the shares going to the U.S. and China have declined, the ministry said.

item.title: Aware of proposed US bill to raise tariffs to 500 pc, dealing with 'great care': Govt
item.description: Emphasising that ensuring stable energy prices and secured supplies have been the twin goals of the country's energy policy, Ministry of External Affairs (MEA) spokesperson Randhir Jaiswal said during a weekly briefing that the country has focused its attention on the evolving issues around the US bill, titled the "Sanctioning of Russia Act 2025".

item.title: Who is with Yash in Toxic trailer's car scene; see her official Instagram profile
item.description: Set against the eerie silence of a cemetery, the video opens with a burial in progress before cutting to Yash's character seated in a car with a woman in an intimate moment. Behind them, a bomb is placed, yet the two remain completely unfazed.

item.title: Deputy speaker post still vacant in J&K Assembly; BJP targets NC government ahead of Budget session
item.description: Over 14 months after taking office, the Omar Abdullah–led NC government has not appointed a Deputy Speaker, prompting the BJP, the principal opposition party, to demand adherence to legislative convention.

item.title: Geetu Mohandas takes subtle dig at trolls over Yash's car scene in Toxic teaser
item.description: Apart from Yash's action-packed moments, the teaser also had an intimate love-making scene in a car, which garnered headlines over the many other positive aspects shown in the teaser. Filmmaker Geetu Mohandas has reacted to trolls in her new post.
